_: How shorts look and which services make them. Prices are fal's, per second of video, as of Nov 2026: check fal.ai/models if they change.

scene._: Each episode's environment, painted from its script's scene: line (lib/scenes.mjs) and kept in shorts/backgrounds/.
scene.style: Photoreal 3D render of an empty set in a grotesque body-horror world where everything is made of skin, flesh, teeth, hair and goo: wet, glossy, organic surfaces, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, moody and a little dark, eye-level view. No people, no creatures, no faces, no text or lettering anywhere. Keep the middle of the picture fairly plain and uncluttered, where characters will be placed.

style: grotesque, wet, glossy 3D creature render; unhinged, psychotic, frenetic cartoon acting: manic twitching, sudden jerky head movements, eyes darting and bulging, huge rubbery expressions snapping between extremes.

pace._: The gap after each line, in seconds (lines ending in ... still linger, lines ending in — get none).

voice._: provider fal: voices designed from each character's brief (ElevenLabs v3 on fal, $0.10 per 1000 characters, commercial use included). provider elevenlabs: the stock voices named in cast.json, through your own ElevenLabs account.

action.negative: blur, distortion, low quality, extra limbs, text, watermark, human hands

edit._: Draws characters turned left and right (lib/poses.mjs), on fal.

props._: Props (prop: in a script), drawn once each and kept in shorts/props/.
props.style: Photoreal 3D render, grotesque, wet and glossy, organic and crusty, cinematic lighting, like a gross stop-motion puppet prop.

music._: Music under the title: it fades away as the first line is said (until: "first line"; anything else keeps it under the whole episode). Each track is the game's Suno music given a treatment once: the creepy ones are slowed, detuned, darkened and drowned in echo.

sounds._: A script's sounds: line is made into a looping environment once (ElevenLabs sound effects on fal, $0.002 a second), kept in shorts/sounds/, and played at `loudness` (LUFS; the voices are about -16).

ambience._: A bed of sound under everything, so silences aren't dead air (a script's ambience: picks another, or none).

hits._: Sound hits on the camera's punches, shakes and snaps to close-ups, made once each.

sounds.hit: a single short wet fleshy slap impact, cartoon, punchy
sounds.rattle: a short violent wet rattling shudder, like something fleshy being shaken hard, cartoon
sounds.whoosh: a very fast short cartoon whoosh, a quick swish of air

energy._: frantic: the camera trembles and snaps in at random (a script's energy: calm turns it off). jitter is pixels; jolts come every so many seconds and zoom in by so much.

vhs._: Bursts of VHS static (picture and sound), every few seconds and only between lines. A script's vhs: off turns them off.
